verdicts.originalText: HP drain: 3.0%/2.5%/2.0% (T1/T6/T13) of current HP per second once the stance opens (not modelled). Stance ends if Xiao swaps off-field.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the HP drain each second while the stance is active.
verdicts.rationale: The caveat mixes a real omission with working behavior and uses the banned double-L 'modelled' spelling, so a rewrite is required regardless. Claim 1 (continuous HP drain) is a genuine gap: HP drain is an onHPChange-class mechanic on the CANNOT list, so it stays flagged with the 'Not modeled:' stock pattern. Claim 2 ('Stance ends if Xiao swaps off-field') describes working behavior — the burst carries terminatesOnSwap: true, which is wired end-to-end (CAN list), and the timeline correctly ends the stance on swap — so it is dropped. The character name 'Xiao' is stripped per the naming rule, and the exact per-talent-level drain percentages are compressed out (following the Raiden-C6 worked example) since they are talent-breakpoint detail already documented in the A6 curator note and do not change what the timeline should show.

claimsLost.claim: HP drain is 3.0%/2.5%/2.0% of current HP per second at talent levels T1/T6/T13 (decreasing with talent level)
Stance ends if Xiao swaps off-field

demotedNotes: Caveat HP-drain specifics (demoted, kept concise in the note above): 3.0%/2.5%/2.0% of current HP per second at talent levels 1/6/13 — drain decreases with talent level. Already fully captured in the A6 rigor 2026-07-12 curator note on this ability.
